items.title: Regulation Crypto is here: State of Crypto
items.summary: The SEC published its Reg Crypto proposal last week, giving the public 60 days to comment.

items.title: Tether’s $120 million Uruguay bitcoin mining project collapsed over a power contract dispute: Reuters
items.summary: UTE cut power to Tether's mining sites in July 2025 after Tether representatives did not attend the signing of a revised contract, per the report.

items.title: 63% of Religious Books on Amazon Are Likely AI-Written, Study Finds
items.summary: Witchcraft books had the highest rate of likely AI-generated content at 78%, according to an Originality.ai analysis of more than 2,000 titles.

items.title: XRP on track for biggest weekly gain in 21 months as Treasury buyback spurs 'curve control' hopes
items.summary: XRP’s price has surged by 50% this week, the best performance since November 2024.
